metadata.mirror:about: MASTER-INWARD.svg — the FORWARD chain of the project. All inputs / ingest flows / file imports / agentic construction / what we read from the world. Every node has a mirror counterpart in MASTER-OUTWARD.svg via the mirror:id attribute. Updates on one side propagate to the other via the gently-mirror-pair contract. See: /data/Projects/MySpace++/REFLECTION.md
metadata.mirror:crystal-method: sha256(forward_bytes XOR mirror_bytes), zero-pad shorter to longer; v1 method. Daemon will switch to blake3-FNV-interleave once shipped.
metadata.mirror:updated-by: gently (main) — SYNC-7 practice update; bumped kimi-index node count ~38k → 208,550 (actual wc -l of .consolidation/kimi_k26_index.jsonl); mirror-side counterpart updated symmetrically; both crystals match.

g.text: ⟳ MASTER-INWARD.svg — the FORWARD chain · all ingest · all agentic construction
paired with MASTER-OUTWARD.svg via mirror:id · updates one side reflect to the other · crystal = XOR of both chains
Layer 0 — external sources (where bytes enter the system)
CALL: lazy HTTP Range, never bulk
no logins · no ads · no phishing
FBX magic-byte sniff guards HTML errs
key in URL bearer / cookie / header
Layer 1 — agentic ingest flows (how files become chain ops)
trigger: new model URL OR refresh tick
1. for each probe in std lib
trigger: user types `cc -chain "a | b - c | d"`
agent: cc Python wrapper + cc-chain parser
3. dispatch each step to its handler
Layer 2 — runtime construction (.bb composition + chain assembly)
Layer 3 — storage layer (where ingest + construction persists)
Layer 4 — 6 constitutional principles (what protects the forward chain)
7 frozen symbols: f ~ d l s a m+/-/*/
If bug looks like gently-bb, it isn't.
every op has anti at mirror position
used at: genesis install + per-commit envelope
8 lines of Rust ship the orchestrator
Layer 5 — mirror bridge to MASTER-OUTWARD.svg (every node above has a counterpart)
how the reflection works (this side = forward chain; sister SVG = mirror chain)
1. every node here declares mspc:src-id, mspc:flow-id, mspc:construct-id, mspc:store-id, OR mspc:principle-id
2. that ID is ALSO declared on the counterpart node in MASTER-OUTWARD.svg via the matching mirror:id attribute
3. when this side updates (e.g., a new HF model is scraped, a new probe calibration is filed),
the gently-mirror-pair daemon walks the IDs and updates the sister node's status field in MASTER-OUTWARD.svg
4. the daemon never replaces shapes / colors / layout — it only mutates data-* fields + the crystal hash in <metadata>
5. both SVGs share a single chain-of-truth: SealedChain { forward = INWARD, mirror = OUTWARD, crystal = XOR(fwd, mir) }
6. updating either side without updating the other breaks the crystal — the daemon will refuse to extend chain until repaired
7. agentic flows are first-class: every flow declares an ingress (here) and an egress (sister), wired automatically
8. ALL files imported / constructed / stored on this side flow back as published surfaces on the sister side
MASTER-INWARD.svg v1.0.0 · the forward chain · paired with MASTER-OUTWARD.svg · crystal axiom: INWARD ⊕ OUTWARD = SealedChain.crystal
